final: {"number": 749, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/InjectMocks.java"], "reply": "The stubs are never used because CalculatorServiceSpringImpl creates its own services with new AddServiceSpringImpl() and new SubtractServiceSpringImpl(). Stubbing the mocks in the test does not touch those fields, so the real code runs and returns its own values. Give the class the mocks instead, for example through its constructor or a setter, then call result(). Mockito.mock(Class) creates the mocks. If you prefer annotations, @InjectMocks (org.mockito.InjectMocks) injects mock fields into the class under test, but only into fields the class does not already set. Mocking the interface types is cleaner than mocking the Impl classes."}
